## `get_project_name`

*Available in [R](#get_project_name-r), [Python](#get_project_name-python)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function returns the Project Name or blank if none exists.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    get_project_name()

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>
    *No arguments*
    <h4>Returns</h4>

    A character string with the project name


=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    None
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python

    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project` (`CIDAProject`) - None
